verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust framework installed locally with `cargo install proa-cli`. Its apps run as your own Axum server, and it can be adapted to other HTTP servers or runtimes, so the core product runs entirely on user-controlled infrastructure with nothing vendor-hosted required. Its source is published on GitHub, and UI components are vendored into your repo. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement, documentation for production self-hosting and deployment, and independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosted production use.
